operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Adds a cost center. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The request body is a flat JSON object. The account layer applies **no field validation** here, so the only hard requirements are the two fields the database cannot default: `cost_center_id` and `cost_center_ids`. Omitting either fails with a `400`.

In practice you should always send `name` and `code` as well — if omitted they are silently stored as an empty name and an empty/`0` code, which is rarely useful. `code` must be **unique** across the account; a duplicate `code` fails with a `400`.

`is_primary` marks a cost center as primary (root) or secondary (child):

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Primary (root) |
| 0 | Secondary (child); defaults to `0` when omitted |

`cost_center_id` is the id of the parent cost center — send `0` for a primary/root cost center, or the parent's id for a child. `cost_center_ids` is the comma-separated ancestor path of parent ids; it **must be non-empty** (an empty string is rejected), and it is not maintained automatically, so the caller supplies it.

`branch_id`, `status`, `id`, `created` and `modified` are assigned by the server and are not settable through this endpoint.

On success the response is `{ "message": "...", "id": <new id> }`. The message is localized to the caller's language (for example `Cost center Added Successfully` in English).

cost_center_id.description: Required. Id of the parent cost center. Send `0` for a primary/root cost center, or the parent's id for a child.

cost_center_ids.description: Required, must be non-empty. Comma-separated ancestor path of parent cost-center ids (an empty string is rejected).

name.description: Cost center name. Strongly recommended — stored as an empty string if omitted.

code.description: Cost center code. Strongly recommended and must be unique across the account (a duplicate is rejected); stored as `0`/empty if omitted.

is_primary.description:
Whether this is a primary (root) cost center. Defaults to `0` when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Primary (root) |
| 0 | Secondary (child) |

id.description: Id of the newly created cost center.

400.description: The cost center could not be saved — for example `cost_center_id` or `cost_center_ids` was missing, `cost_center_ids` was empty, or the `code` duplicates an existing one.

e.description: Error detail object (present for database-level failures).

error.description: Reason the record could not be saved — for example a required field (`cost_center_id` / `cost_center_ids`) was missing, `cost_center_ids` was empty, or the `code` already exists.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.
